This petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C by accused Nos.2 to 6 in Crime No.239/2022 of Kundgol police station, registered for offences punishable under sections 323, 498-A, 354(a), 504,
506 and 149 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Heard both the sides and perused the material on record.
3.
The complaint is lodged by the wife of accused No.1.
Petitioners are the parents, sisters and brother of accused No.1.
The case of the prosecution is that the marriage of complainant was performed with accused No.1 on 08.02.2020.
The complainant's husband i.e., accused No.1 went to Dubai for employment after one month of the marriage.

The complainant was being subjected to cruelty in her marital home by her in laws i.e., the petitions herein and they were demanding dowry from her saying that Rs.2,00,000/- given at the time of marriage was not sufficient and she has to Abdul Munaf Abdul Sattar Mirjankar vs The Police Sub Inspector on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/45548651/
2 get more dowry as they had taken loan of Rs.13,00,000/- for construction of house.

sentences.text: Unable to tolerate the harassment, in the month of August-2020 she returned to her parental home.
She gave birth to a baby girl.
She came to know from Instagram that her husband was having affair with other girls.
In the month of September-2021 her husband returned from Dubai and promised that she will be looked after properly and took her back to matrimonial home.
Again in the month of October-2021 he went back to Dubai and thereafter started abusing her in phone saying that she should not stay in her matrimonial house and she should stay with her mother.
Again the petitioners started demanding a sum of Rs.13,00,000/- as dowry.
Her father in law was making sexual gestures at her and behaving in an indecent manner by pulling her hands etc.
On 25.08.2022 at about 11:00 a.m., all the petitioners picked up quarrel and assaulted her, snatched her tali and threatened her etc.

4. It is contended by the learned counsel for petitioners that the entire allegations are false and due to matrimonial discord between the husband and wife, a false case is registered against the entire family members.
He contended that the complainant has suppressed the fact that she was with accused No.1 in Dubai between 17.05.2022 and 15.08.2022.
He has relied on copies of the flight tickets produced at Annexures-D and E.

He would further contend that petitioner No.3/ accused No.4 is married and she is residing separately in Hubballi and petitioner Nos.4 and 5/ accused Nos.5 and 6 are also staying in Hubballi, at their work place.
5.
Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 are the aged parents of accused No.1.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for petitioners that the other petitioners are residing separately along with their family members in Hubballi.
It is also contended by him that the complainant was residing in Dubai between 17.05.2022 and 15.08.2022 and the same has been suppressed by her in her complaint.
It is relevant to see that the alleged incident of assault took place according to the complaint on 25.08.2022.
There is no material to show that the said incident was brought to the notice of others immediately.
The complaint is lodged on 22.12.2022 which is nearly after four months of the said incident.
The allegations made in the complaint have to be established in due course.
The custodial interrogation of the petitioners is not required.
Petitioners can be directed to cooperate with the investigation.
Hence, by imposing necessary conditions, the relief sought can be granted.

6. Accordingly the following;
 ORDER  i) Petition is allowed,
ii) In the event of arrest of the petitioners/ accused Nos.2 to 6 in Crime No.229/2022 of Mundagod police station, they shall be released subject to following conditions:

3 a) Petitioners shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of ten days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) each, with two sureties for the likesum,
b) They shall make themselves available for the purpose of investigation as and when required and they shall co-operate with the investigation,
c) They shall furnish their address proof and shall inform the Investigation Officer/Court if there is any change in the address,
d) They shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly,
e) They shall appear before the trial Court on all dates of hearing without fail unless exempted for any genuine cause.
